name: Dissolve It

features.text: Removes built-up contaminants and debris quickly and easily.
Can avoid the need for disassembly of parts.
Just spray and allow surface to dry.
Contains no fluorocarbons or chlorinated solvents.
Not for sale or use in California and OTC States.

description: A specially formulated blend of solvents designed to dissolve, disperse and remove contaminants and other organic material from a variety of surfaces. This non-chlorinated, CFC-free formula dries quickly and does not leave a residue or oily film behind. The multi-purpose solvent works well on metal parts, equipment and for various automotive or industrial uses.
application: First test product on an inconspicuous area to determine color fastness and compatibility before using on entire surface. 1. Hold can 8 to 12 inches from surface to be cleaned. 2. Spray liberally until surface is clean. 3. Allow to air dry or remove excess with an absorbent towel or cloth. Note: For harder-to-remove contaminants, spray a clean cloth with product and wipe surface.
